status_definitions.api: Public, documented API for the source or its data.
status_definitions.rss: Published RSS feed; usually summaries and links, not complete articles.
status_definitions.partial: Related structured data exists, but full coverage of the listed page is unverified.
status_definitions.mcp: Documented Model Context Protocol interface, not a conventional REST API.
status_definitions.none_found: No public, documented machine-readable interface confirmed during this review.
